Subject: SUN Type8830, one stationary mutated TREE organism. A tall stout weathered pale grey-brown trunk widens into a short splayed root base. A band of many small embedded human faces is fused into the upper-middle trunk; these are bark-fused surface forms, not detached heads or separate people. Green moss coats the lower trunk. Above the faces sit exactly THREE large flower buds distributed around the trunk: pink-red petals with pale green edges, six fleshy petals on an open bud. The foremost bloom opens toward the viewer/right, exposing its short thick serpentine head and crooked needle teeth. The other two side buds remain partly closed. Above these blooms, a crown of numerous thin long pale-brown tentacles with dark transverse stripes radiates outward and curves back inward. Preserve that striped whip crown; this is not a normal leafy tree or a yellow sunflower. THREE separate thinner vine-like grasping Sunsun appendages emerge between the face band and flowers, each ending in a small six-fingered petal mouth with grey claw tips, two clearly visible to either side and the third curling behind the trunk.
Pose/framing: a full freestanding tree silhouette in a gentle three-quarter view; all roots, tentacle tips, flower petals and branch tips fit inside the square with at least 7 percent transparent padding. Keep appendages elegantly curved within the frame, not cut at the sides. The tall trunk continues above the whip crown into short bare forked branches, ending visibly inside the canvas; that bounded top and compact root extent are a free gallery framing adaptation of the environmental boss. Keep the trunk upright, do not give it legs, arms, a human body or a single large human face. No ground disk or pot.
Match the original game's strange pale bark, moss, red-green flowers, striped tendrils and face band without inventing new colors or armor. Readable individual contours in a detailed painted sprite, not photoreal or a low-poly game screenshot. True transparent background; no laboratory, ground, shadows outside the roots, particles, pollen projectiles, blood spray, victim, text, labels, HUD, border, watermark, grid, duplicate plant or alternate view. This is one free static 2D gallery adaptation, not a claim that the complete environmental organism was visible in the original camera.
